stories.headline: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
stories.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

stories.headline: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
stories.summary: Canada's levies - as high as 50% - will apply to nearly $20bn of US products, from steel to T-shirts.

stories.headline: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
stories.summary: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"

stories.headline: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
stories.summary: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

stories.headline: Kenya's foreign trader crackdown sparks fear among migrant communities
stories.summary: Kenya's president orders a crackdown on foreigners running small businesses, amid accusations of xenophobia.

stories.headline: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
stories.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

stories.headline: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
stories.summary: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

stories.headline: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
stories.summary: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
stories.summary: The Iran-backed Yemeni group's attacks have injured 73 people and caused fires at oil facilities, Saudi authorities say.

stories.headline: New Yorkers were 'lied' to about toxic air after 9/11 attacks, says Mamdani
stories.summary: Newly released documents show toxins lingered for months after the attacks, but officials told people it was safe.

stories.headline: Sudan's healthcare system on brink of collapse after cuts, medical charity warns
stories.summary: Médecins Sans Frontières is urging world leaders to increase funding to help the millions who need aid.

stories.headline: Sabotage suspect held in Germany after spate of attacks on power grid
stories.summary: The suspect had reportedly claimed responsibility for attacks on electricity substations in letters.

stories.headline: AI will cure cancer in our lifetime, claims boss of UK chip giant
stories.summary: Arm Holding's chief executive Rene Haas says artificial intelligence will find a solution to the disease.

stories.headline: Germany's far-right AfD celebrate projected win in state election
stories.summary: AfD leaders celebrated tonight as exit polls projected a big lead in the Saxony-Anhalt vote.

stories.headline: Trump threatens to stop sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in US
stories.summary: The threat against one of Canada's largest companies comes amid an escalating trade war between the two neighbours.

stories.headline: How much can Canada fight back in its trade war with the US?
stories.summary: The US may be the bigger trading partner, but Canada shouldn't be counted out quite yet in the escalating trade fight.

stories.headline: With the midterms fast approaching, campaign season begins
stories.summary: Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season as Republicans work to maintain control of the House and the Senate amid President Trump's unpopular second term.

stories.headline: GOP to host unusual midterm convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
stories.summary: Republicans are aiming to get voters to turn out for the midterms with an unconventional convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. went into effect at midnight.

stories.headline: Russia and North Korea open the first road across their shared border
stories.summary: Relations between Russia and North Korea have been flourishing, with North Korea supplying ammunition and troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine in return for economic and military assistance.
